description: A script to download, unpack, and update a specific version of the Clang toolchain from Chromium's repository, with functions for downloading URLs, retrying operations, and managing the Clang version stamp.

methods.name: DownloadUrl
methods.description: Downloads content from a URL and writes it to an output file, displaying progress dots.

methods.name: Retry
methods.description: Retries a function call multiple times with exception handling and delay.

methods.name: DownloadAndUnpack
methods.description: Downloads a tar.gz archive from a URL and extracts it to a specified directory.

methods.name: UpdateClang
methods.description: Downloads, unpacks, and stamps a specific Clang version from Chromium's binary releases.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and initiates the Clang update process.
